items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the internal fitting. The same-policy reference supports €52 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that need renewal with the fractured valve. The same-policy reference supports €27 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary repair labour. Three hours at the reference rate of about €98 gross per hour give approximately €295.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 3.6 distinguish consumables actually used from excluded contractor equipment or overhead. The generic line does not identify what was used; if substantiated, €10 is a modest allowance.
Section 7.1.11 allows one attendance for the covered plumbing work. The closest same-policy reference supports €41 gross for that attendance.

Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to trace the escape, notwithstanding the general tools exclusion. €40 is an allowance for equipment use alone, below the €2,500 gross event cap.
Section 7.1.11 excludes a separately billed return visit without advance approval, and none is stated. €41 is the conditional value of one attendance if approval were established.

The agreed frost endorsement covers removal of failed render under 2.6.2. Allow €90 gross for the two removal units together, consistent with the small volume of debris and separately billed painter hours.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster in the damaged patches. Allow €55 gross for the material line, with labour billed separately.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover re-forming the damaged substrate. Allow €95 gross for distinct patch-preparation work without duplicating base plaster or separately billed hours.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7 cover necessary priming of the repaired surface. Allow €35 gross for the affected patches, excluding separately billed labour.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying only where needed before reinstatement. The invoice does not specify the method or duration, so €65 gross assumes a modest, necessary drying measure.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover only the coats required by the equivalent pre-loss finish system on the damaged area. Allow €100 gross for paint, without assuming all four billed coats were necessary.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the damaged elevation, not the separately billed rear repaint. Five hours at €70 gross per hour give €350.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.8 cover necessary scaffold hire, erection and dismantling. At roughly 50 m², €650 gross allows for a small two-storey setup; no rear-work allocation is needed because the scaffold was removed before that work.
Sections 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting a separate undamaged elevation, even for appearance matching. €450 is a conditional gross estimate for a straightforward ladder-access repaint.
Sections 2.6.2 and 5.2.1 cover transport and disposal of debris from the insured repair. Allow €50 gross for a few rubble sacks.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude a separate administration charge that prices no repair work. €15 is a conditional estimate only.
Section 3.6(a) excludes crew catering even on covered work. The conditional estimate is three portions at €10 gross each.
